source.section: Retirement Income Exemption Worksheet, Sections I and II (booklet PDF p.16; IN-112 Instructions PDF p.2); Schedule IN-112 Part I Line 12 (booklet PDF p.23); Form IN-111 Lines 1-8 and 14 (booklet PDF pp.10-11), standard deduction chart and Lines 4-5e (PDF p.11), rate schedules (PDF p.46)

worked: Federal taxable Social Security: provisional income = other income 48,000.00 + half of benefits 10,000.00 = 58,000.00; 85% x (58,000.00 - 34,000.00) + 4,500.00 = 24,900.00, limited to 85% x 20,000.00 = 17,000.00; taxable 17,000.00. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 48,000.00 + taxable Social Security 17,000.00 = 65,000.00. Federal taxable income = 65,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 49,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form IN-111, Single: Line 1 federal AGI 65,000.00. Schedule IN-112 Part I: Line 1 all state and local obligation interest 0.00; Line 2 Vermont obligations 0.00; Line 3 = 0.00; Line 4 0.00; Line 6 total additions 0.00. Retirement Income Exemption Worksheet (Social Security elected): question 2, AGI 65,000.00 is not less than 65,000.00: no exemption. Line 12 0.00. Subtractions: Line 12 retirement benefits (Social Security) 0.00; Line 18 total subtractions 0.00. Line 19 net modifications = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00. Form IN-111 Line 2 0.00; Line 3 = 65,000.00 + (0.00) = 65,000.00. Line 4 standard deduction 7,650.00 (no age box) [person 0 born 1961-05-05 (not born before Jan. 2, 1961: no box)]. Line 5a-5d personal exemptions 1; Line 5e 1 x 5,300.00 = 5,300.00. Line 6 = 7,650.00 + 5,300.00 = 12,950.00. Line 7 Vermont taxable income = 65,000.00 - 12,950.00 = 52,050.00. Line 8: schedule tax on 52,050.00 (Schedule X, booklet p.46, merged continuous schedule): 3.35% x (49,400.00 - 0.00) = 1,654.90 + 6.6% x (52,050.00 - 49,400.00) = 174.90 = 1,829.80; the tax table (pp.47-51) gives 1830. Federal AGI 65,000.00 is not greater than 150,000.00, so no minimum tax: Line 8 1,829.80. Line 9 0.00 (no Schedule IN-119 items; Credit for the Elderly or the Disabled not modelled); Line 10 1,829.80; Lines 11-13 0.00; Line 14 Vermont income tax 1,829.80.
accepted_approximations: The rate schedule is one continuous schedule: the printed rows that restart at 75,000 are merged and printed base taxes, rounded to the dollar, are not used. Below 75,000 the booklet uses tax tables in 100 dollar rows.
